newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 70 in wedding party die in India accident.
newsitem.headline: At least 70 in wedding party die in India accident.

text.p: At least 70 people were killed when a truck carrying them to a wedding party overturned in northern India, local news agencies said on Friday.

Rescuers had brought 65 bodies to Hamirpur village in the mountainous state of Himachal Pradesh while emergency workers were trying to pull at least five more bodies from under the wreckage, the agencies quoted officials as saying.

United News of India said eight of the passengers were injured, including five seriously, in the accident which took place on Thursday night. The Press Trust of India said the truck was carrying 90 people.
Earlier on Friday, All India Radio reported that the vehicle in the accident was a bus which had plunged into a gorge.
